description:
Packing Optimizer evaluates your available box or bin sizes to calculate the most volume-efficient loading plan for your item list. Input item dimensions alongside one or more candidate bin types to automatically receive detailed loading layouts that minimize total container usage and wasted space.

Key features:
    - Flexible bin selection: Evaluates single or multiple available bin sizes to find the best packing configuration.
    - Exact loading instructions: Provides 3D placement coordinates (X, Y, Z) and specific rotation angles for every item.
    - Volume reduction: Minimizes total shipping volume and container count to lower transport costs.

defaultPrompt: Pack 50 boxes (40x30x25 cm) into 120x80 cm or 120x100 cm pallets, picking the most space-efficient option
